name: Medical
one_line: The safety domain that fires so a person's health material is recognised and protected before any cloud prompt or automated placement decision. It declares NO field rows (D1 as narrowed, _CONTRACT rule 15, CONNECTION PR-6), so activation unlocks protection plus the universal facts only, and it recommends NO folder dimensions - a medical branch's own labels would publish in folder names exactly what the protection exists to hide.
design_cite: 00 names this domain and its launch posture outright: "Finance, identity, medical, and legal material should be implemented first as safety domains, meaning the system detects and protects them before any cloud or automated placement decision is allowed." 00 also names the material: "A scanned passport, tax statement, medical document, authentication key, or account record should enter a protected state immediately", and gives it a residual home: "Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials; it should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts."

deterministic: PRECONDITION on every entry in this list: each is a DETECTION signal, not an extraction licence. It answers only whether this material is present, so that P7 can protect it before anything else runs - 00: "Privacy policy must be enforced before content reaches any model or external connector." No signal here writes a fact, because this schema declares no field rows

a clinical result table: a labelled table whose rows each carry a measurement or test name, a result value with units, and a reference range, in the table structure 00's extraction preserves - "Tables matter because resumes, forms, applications, invoices, and administrative documents often place their most useful information in cells rather than body paragraphs." This copies 00's pattern-plus-context SHAPE ("a course-code pattern together with academic context") onto a different structure; the term vocabulary is PROPOSED (see proposed_context_terms) and is never claimed as a list 00 wrote

a patient-identification block: labelled slots for a person's name and date of birth beside a record-number-shaped token, in a high-weight zone, co-occurring with a provider-or-facility gazetteer hit matched at a word boundary - 00: "It should use word-boundary matching rather than substring matching", and "It should use positional weighting because a value in a filename or document title carries more meaning than the same value in a footer or a late body-page reference." R4 owns the gazetteer's contents; this row writes no names and no regex

a medication-label structure in OCR regions or a labelled document zone: a drug name beside a strength or dose, directions for use, a dispensing pharmacy, and a refill or prescription-number slot - the token alone is never sufficient (see never_alone)
an immunization or vaccination record structure: a repeated row shape of vaccine name, administration date, and an administering-site or lot slot, in a table zone

an insurer claim or benefits-statement structure: a claim identifier beside a date-of-service slot, a rendering provider, and amount-billed / amount-allowed / patient-responsibility cells. This is the one evidence item finance can read equally well, so it is resolved per-item under CONNECTION section 4 step 3 and carries the collides_with signal to finance

a health-application export archive: a manifest naming the app's export document and its category-partitioned members, read from the manifest alone - 00: "the normal scan should never extract archive contents to the filesystem", and the archive extractor "should read and store the archive type, contained paths, filenames, folder names, extensions, file count, uncompressed size where available, and recognizable markers such as source-code manifests or document names"

a calendar event whose labelled SUMMARY or LOCATION slot names a clinical appointment kind together with a provider gazetteer hit at word boundary. The CONTENT fires; source_type = calendar contributed only as a file-kind signal (CONNECTION-EXAMPLES fixture 5)

an email whose labelled sender slot resolves to a care-provider or patient-portal domain and whose labelled subject slot carries a results, appointment, or portal-message term - 00's email extractor yields "sender, recipients, subject, sent date, thread identifiers, message body, attachment names, and reply-chain context" as structured slots, "while treating addresses and message content as potentially sensitive"
needs_llm: PRECONDITION on every entry in this list: this is protected material, so a model step runs only after P7 classification and only under the user's policy - 00: "Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default", and where a model is genuinely needed, "If a model needs text containing sensitive content, the user should see that requirement and choose whether to allow a local model, a cloud model, a redacted prompt, or no model use." A local model under fully-offline or local-model mode is the default reading of every line below
an unlabelled clinician narrative - a letter, a note, a discharge summary written as prose with no labelled result table and no patient block

an OCR'd portal screenshot: whether it is a patient-portal page rather than a generic image. 00's worked parallel is the admissions confirmation screenshot, and its own warning is that "IMG_4821.png may be a screenshot of a receipt, application portal, conversation, code error, or research figure"

separating medical TOPIC from a personal health record - a nursing lecture, a health article, a de-identified teaching case. 00 gives the model exactly this class of determination: it "may determine whether an extracted document appears to be an application essay, research artifact, recruiting document, travel record, or other supported domain"

whether a record is about the holder or about another person in the household. The model must abstain rather than assert a subject - 00: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown"
a discharge summary, lab report, or claim in a language whose labelled-slot vocabulary the deterministic structure catalogue does not cover

a packet in which a medical document is a supporting member of a non-medical purpose - a school health form inside an admissions packet, an accommodation letter inside an academic file. 00's shape: "an ID, transcript, resume, personal statement, award certificate, and portal screenshot may be content-incoherent but purpose-coherent as an application submission"
never_alone: a medical or anatomical topic term alone. An anatomy lecture deck, a saved health article, and a recipe with a nutrition note are all dense in clinical vocabulary and none is a health record. 00: "Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for." This is the tempting false file for this node and the collision fixture below (Anatomy Lecture 04)

a hospital, clinic, insurer, or pharmacy gazetteer hit alone. 00 states the ambiguity for a university - "A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization" - and the same six-role problem holds here by extension: a hospital name may be an employer, a research site, a teaching institution, a billing counterparty, or a caption in a photograph (provenance: inference; 00 writes this sentence about a university, not a hospital)

source_type alone - image, ocr, archive, calendar, email, spreadsheet, presentation, opaque_binary. 00: the engine should "treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning", and file_kind_plausible is constitutionally never-alone (CONNECTION section 5, invariant 2). A .dcm or a .pdf is not medical because of its format

a bare 4-digit number read as a date of service or a plan year. 00: filenames carry "numbers that look like years but are course identifiers, version numbers, build numbers, ZIP codes, or other unrelated values"

the absence of EXIF as proof that a health-app or portal capture is a screenshot - 00: "the system must not mistake the absence of EXIF for proof that an image is a screenshot" - and dense OCR text as proof either way: "OCR text density is also not a reliable screenshot detector because receipts, document scans, whiteboards, and photographs of pages can all contain dense text"
membership in a download session that happened to drop several PDFs from one portal at once. 00: "A session should never be treated as proof of topic"

a person's name alone, including a PDF or DOCX author or producer string naming a clinic's document template or an EHR export tool. 00: "PDF metadata should be treated as supporting evidence, not as truth", and "a value such as python-docx, Mozilla/5.0, or a browser-generated producer string should not be mistaken for meaningful content"
a parent folder named Health, Medical, or Insurance alone. Folder context is a clue and 00 requires that existing structure not be silently reinterpreted

a drug-name-shaped or condition-shaped token inside a supermarket receipt, a shopping list, or a fitness article. The medication-label structure around it is what supports the signal, and word-boundary matching is what keeps the token from being found inside an unrelated word

grouping_reasons: one episode of care: one provider and one date of service tying an order, a result, a visit summary, and its benefits statement together. Membership stays reviewable and copies nothing - 00: "The graph does not automatically copy those missing facts onto sparse files."
one person's records inside a household - the SUBJECT of the record, which is exactly the fact this schema may not yet write, so the neighbourhood may exist while no subject fact does
one repeatedly re-downloaded portal export, joined by the universal duplicate_family and version_family facts rather than by any medical fact

no group at all is still a valid outcome here: 00 surfaces isolated protected material anyway - "Rare but sensitive files such as passports, visas, and legal documents may be surfaced as protected records even when they do not meet a normal group-size threshold"

template.why: EMPTY TWICE OVER, and neither reason is a refusal. (1) By contract: a dimension may only branch on a field the same schema declares, and this placeholder declares none (D1 as narrowed, _CONTRACT rules 10 and 15, CONNECTION PR-6). (2) By safety, independently of (1): the dimensions a medical tree would naturally take - a condition, a specialty, a provider, a person - become visible folder LABELS, publishing in the namespace exactly what the protection exists to hide. 00 pushes the other way even inside the product's own UI: "Protected branches should have configurable redaction in the canvas and review screens", and the Protected Records home "should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts". CONNECTION section 4 step 5 states the same rule for activation: a safety schema's activation unlocks protection plus its small schema only, and no deep template unlocks from it. If field rows are ever decided, the recorded starting recommendation is held as PROSE and is deliberately shallow - the person the record is about, then the record kind - never a condition or diagnosis level; and not time-first, per 00: "For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders." That prose is a note for whoever answers the open_question, not a dimension_order.

collides_with.signal: an explanation of benefits, a medical bill, a coverage card, and a pharmacy receipt all carry an insurer or provider name beside money columns. The discriminating evidence is structural: a claim / amount-billed / patient-responsibility or account-statement table is the finance record; a result-and-reference-range table, a medication-label structure, or a patient-identification block is medical. The insurer name alone counts for neither. This pair also carries also_holds_with (PR-8), so this signal exists to keep ONE evidence item from counting twice.

a coverage card, a vaccination card carried as proof, and a hospital-issued card all pair a person's name with an identifier number, which is also the shape of an identity document. The discriminating evidence: an issuing-authority plus document-type structure (a travel or licence document) is identity; a coverage, plan, or clinical structure around the same name-and-number pair is medical. A name beside a number discriminates nothing on its own.

medical TOPIC material - anatomy or nursing lectures, clinical case teaching decks, health coursework - reads as clinical text end to end, and school health forms carry a school name beside a clinic stamp. The discriminating evidence: a course-code pattern with academic context, or a coursework work type, is academic; a patient-identification block, a result table, or a medication structure naming a real person is medical. Clinical vocabulary alone activates neither side.

study protocols, blank consent forms, de-identified datasets, and IRB packets describe clinical procedures without being anyone's health record. The discriminating evidence: a project identifier, an approval-number slot, or participant-facing framing is research; a named subject with a record-number slot, a result-and-reference-range table, or a dispensing structure is medical. This pair also carries also_holds_with for the signed-copy case, so the signal is what keeps one procedure description from counting for both.

also_holds_with.signal: CONNECTION PR-8, stated for this node: insurance is templates over the Finance schema vocabulary, and where healthcare insurance touches medical material the medical safety placeholder co-activates by this edge while still writing no fields (PR-6). One explanation-of-benefits file legally carries the finance fields (institution, record_type) on its claim-and-amounts evidence and medical protection on its clinical evidence - disjoint evidence, one file, no merge. CONNECTION-EXAMPLES fixture 8 records the same edge from the finance side. Provenance: inference (PR-8 is a provisional rule of the connection contract, not a sentence in 00).

an advance directive, a healthcare power of attorney, a disability or injury claim file, and a signed release are legal instruments about health. 00's privacy sentence names both kinds of material in one corpus list: the product "processes a highly personal corpus that can include identity documents, account statements, tax records, medical information, legal records, credentials, private correspondence, GPS metadata, employment materials, and educational records." legal is a field-less safety placeholder too, so today this join carries protection on both sides and fields on neither. Provenance: inference.

a school-required immunization record, a sports-participation physical, and an accommodation or disability letter are academic-domain artifacts (they carry a school, and they belong to a school year) and medical material at once. Same disjoint-evidence shape as 00's abstract that is Research and Applications together - "A file may validly belong to more than one accepted group". This edge is authored one-way here; R1c owes the reciprocal on the already-landed academic node. Provenance: inference.

when the holder is the PARTICIPANT rather than the investigator, their own signed consent form and their own returned study results are research artifacts (project, stage, artifact_type) and their own health material simultaneously. The roster's own research.ethics-compliance row records the same crossing. This is the co-activation half of the research pair; the collides_with signal above is the mutex half for de-identified protocols. Provenance: inference.

sensitivity_why: 00 names this material twice in its own privacy language: the corpus "can include identity documents, account statements, tax records, medical information, legal records, credentials, private correspondence, GPS metadata, employment materials, and educational records", and "A scanned passport, tax statement, medical document, authentication key, or account record should enter a protected state immediately." Only 00's phrase is asserted here; the handling class is P7's and is not set on this row.
open_question: Two joined forks, both Joseph's. (1) NJ-2 for THIS domain: when medical material is detected, may the matched clinical text be stored in the local evidence table like any other observation, or should detection store only a protected marker plus a location? 00 keeps extracted text local either way ("Paths, complete extracted text, OCR output, file hashes, image EXIF, GPS, user edits, group memberships, and raw sensitive values should remain local"), but a stored diagnosis string is a larger local surface than a stored 'this is medical' flag, and every later dossier builder reads that table. (2) Which canonical field keys medical gets if D1's deferral ever lifts - and specifically whether it needs a holder-versus-subject role split, since the one fact that most distinguishes these files (whose body this record is about) is a person, and 00 warns that person-identity is a poor destination dimension: "It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension." Because (2) is unanswered, this row's role_split is empty rather than guessed: a role_split names two canonical field keys, and this schema has none. No field row is written here in either case (D1 as narrowed / PR-6).
